# How dangerous is this IAM policy, really?

> Free AWS IAM policy checker: paste a policy, trust policy or bucket policy and see admin wildcards, privilege-escalation actions, NotAction grants and public principals with fixes to review. Runs in your browser, no AWS access needed.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
